primitiveBudget: 11 generated filled SVG bands, 3 pressure zones, 1 woven edge field
commitThreshold: one ordered three-zone pressure crossing, then release
memoryRule: the ordered pass stays geometry-neutral; release spends pressure across the woven bands as shear, split, buckle, or fold; four passes persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch traverses zones 0, 1, and 2; ArrowRight plus Enter uses the same ordered pass; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: punctured SVG mass, singular contour, and paired hinge register -> one continuous filled pressure loom of generated bands
compositionRupture: heavy body, open contour, and sparse joints -> oblique woven field with a central compression throat and no discrete chambers
encounterRupture: witness/answer, two-gate crossing, and three-node route -> one ordered material crossing whose stroke is never displayed
temporalRupture: remote response, knot memory, and route verdict -> pressure is spent through the whole loom in four cumulative material states
mediumRupture: compound paths, chamber polygons, and paired hinges -> generated SVG filled band polygons with produced edge and core geometry
changedRule: An ordered crossing through all three pressure zones remains geometry-neutral. Only release lets the loom spend the crossing as a material load across its own bands; the gesture itself never survives.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is an oblique woven SVG field of eleven filled bands. After release, six or more band polygons change their bend, thickness, and phase as shear, split, buckle, or fold; four loads compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if the crossing paints a cursor trail, if geometry changes before release, if an incomplete or reversed pass commits, if pressure changes only colour/readout, if the blind image reads as a generic linefield, or if later loads reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v043 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the pressure loom from v039-v042 or if the p5.brush translation reads as a skin of colour rather than a changed geometry-production rule.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
